sents.text: Remember the quarry? Every single fight happened right here.
Red led the charge with the Power Sword.
Black brought the thunder with the Power Axe.
Yellow was lightning fast with the Power Daggers.
Pink took the high ground with the Power Bow.
And Green? Green had the Dragon Dagger.
Six rangers. One quarry. Zero putties left. Who was your favorite? Comment below, and follow R G Brick and Stick Verse.
